claims.text: Format: the adolescent is usually seen alone, sometimes with a parent, guardian, partner, spouse or friend; HEEADSSS or SSHADESS can organize the questions.
claims.quote: In most cases, the adolescent will be alone at the visit. In some situations, especially if the adolescent has a special health care need, she may be accompanied by a parent, guardian, partner, spouse, or friend. Some clinicians use the HEEADSSS or SSHADESS mnemonics to help organize the questions for their young adult patients.
claims.locator: 15 through 17 year visits, Health Supervision: History / Review of Systems

claims.text: Ask the adolescent: how they've been since the last visit and any health problems, concerns or questions; how things are going with family, friends, school and work; any question or worry to discuss today.
claims.quote: Since your last visit here, how have you been? What health problems, concerns, or questions have you had? • How are things going with your family, friends, school, and work? • Do you have a question or worry about anything that you would like to talk about today?
claims.locator: 15 through 17 year visits, Health Supervision: History / Review of Systems

claims.text: Ask the parent: questions about physical well-being or growth; concerns about emotional well-being, feelings, behavior or learning; what they've discussed about healthy lifestyle and avoiding risk behaviors.
claims.quote: What questions do you have about your adolescent’s physical well-being or growth? • What questions or concerns do you have about your adolescent’s emotional well-being, feelings, behavior, or learning? • What have you and your adolescent discussed about feelings and behaviors that are contributing to her emotional well-being and a healthy lifestyle? • What have you and your adolescent discussed about avoiding risk behaviors?
claims.locator: 15 through 17 year visits, Health Supervision: History / Review of Systems

claims.text: Past medical hx: any specialty or emergency care since the last visit.
claims.quote: received any specialty or emergency care since the last visit?
claims.locator: 15 through 17 year visits, Health Supervision: History / Review of Systems

claims.text: Family hx: any new health condition or death in the family; if yes, who has or had it, age at onset and diagnosis, or age at death.
claims.quote: developed a new health condition or died? If the answer is Yes: Ascertain who in the family has or had the condition, and ask about the age of onset and diagnosis. If the person is no longer living, ask about the age at the time of death.
claims.locator: 15 through 17 year visits, Health Supervision: History / Review of Systems

claims.text: ROS — any problems with: frequent headaches or dizziness; fainting; eyes or vision; ears or hearing; nose or throat; breathing problems or chest pain; belly pain, vomiting, bowel problems; painful urination or other urine problems; rashes, moles, sunburn; muscle aches, injury or other problems; fatigue. Girls: first period yet; last period; problems with periods; vaginal itching, burning or discharge.
claims.quote: Do you have any problems with • Regular or frequent headaches or dizziness • Fainting or passing out • Eyes or vision • Ears or hearing • Nose or throat • Breathing problems or chest pains • Belly aches or pains, throwing up, problems with bowel movements • Painful urination or other urine problems • Rashes, moles, sunburn • Muscle aches, injury, or other problems • Fatigue For Girls • Have you had your first period? – If so, when was your last period? – Do you have any problems with your periods? – Do you have any itching, burning, or discharge in your vaginal area?
claims.locator: 15 through 17 year visits, Health Supervision: History / Review of Systems
